data.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so that telnet 127.0.0.1 6665 connects to the VM and shows a login prompt, then leave it running and block until ready.
required_artifacts: A listening TCP service on 127.0.0.1:6665 connected to the VM console/serial
required_behaviors: QEMU must be started in the background
Port 6665 on localhost must accept telnet connections
Telnet to 127.0.0.1 6665 must present a login prompt
The VM must remain running after readiness is reached
known_invalid_patterns: Only verifying that qemu launched without confirming telnet/login prompt availability
Treating file existence or ISO presence as success
Returning before the service is actually reachable on 127.0.0.1:6665
verification_plan: Inspect available tools and environment for qemu/telnet support and the ISO path
Start QEMU with a serial console exposed on localhost:6665 in the background
Probe localhost:6665 until the login prompt is observable
Keep the VM process running and report readiness only after receipt-backed evidence
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt showing the exact QEMU launch command and background process start
Receipt showing successful connection to 127.0.0.1:6665 with a login prompt visible
Receipt-backed evidence that the VM remains running at readiness
notes: Prerequisites like missing tools are not task success; they only affect implementation approach.

data.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so telnet 127.0.0.1:6665 reaches a login prompt, then leave it running and block until ready.
data.current_focus: Discover available tooling and launch QEMU with serial console on localhost:6665.
data.implementation_approach: Inspect environment for qemu/telnet and ISO path, then start QEMU with an appropriate serial/monitor configuration exposing telnet on port 6665.
data.validation_strategy: Use receipt-backed probes against localhost:6665 until the login prompt is visible.
data.verification_test_strategy: Confirm the VM is reachable via telnet and presents a login prompt, not just that the process exists.
known_bad_behavior: Assuming launch success without telnet reachability
Using file existence as a proxy for readiness
Stopping after a non-functional smoke check
evidence_gaps: Need evidence of tool availability and exact launch method
Need evidence of telnet login prompt on 127.0.0.1:6665
risks: The ISO may require specific boot flags or console settings
Telnet may need a different serial configuration
next_steps: Launch QEMU in background with serial console on port 6665
finalization_requirements: Receipt-backed evidence of telnet login prompt
Evidence that the VM is still running when declared ready

actions.data:
set -e
command -v qemu-system-x86_64 || command -v qemu-system-i386 || true
command -v telnet || true
ls -l /app/alpine.iso
